definition: P = centre of the fitted top-face circle (radius 0.5 D) of the rigid-disc silhouette model (s3_disc_pose: top + bottom face, thickness 0.031 D), world coords (origin A, X crossbar, Y away, Z up), unit D; camera = smoothed camera of record

Q_minus_P.value_D_world: (+0.0019, +0.0309, 0) in the world-azimuth frame, i.e. constant +0.031 D in world +Y (away from the camera)
Q_minus_P.test: line perpendicular offset vs psi: world-fixed point model rms 0.0058 D; disc-attached chord model (constant offset) rms 0.0229 D -> the line passes through a world-fixed point, not a disc-attached one (AI inconsistency, or a depth bias of the silhouette centre along the view ~ +Y)

systematics: f +-3 % scales positions about the camera (mainly depth/Y and the absolute distance); A placement assumption; disc taken as a rigid circle
